# Hornero OS

> HorneroOS is an Arch-based operating-system family. Its current preview is a Wayland-first desktop powered by Hornero Shell; Hyprland is the supported default compositor and Niri is experimental.

## Status

HorneroOS is pre-release. The Desktop is available as Arch packages for existing Arch systems. Server, Agents, and Studio are defined as composable editions with planned maturity. There is no published ISO or guided installer yet.

- Official site: https://horneroos.com
- Editions: https://horneroos.com/editions
- Themes: https://horneroos.com/themes
- Layouts: https://horneroos.com/layouts

- Composition: https://github.com/HorneroOS/hornero

- Installer contract: https://github.com/HorneroOS/installer
